text:
Oncall Bot: P1 alert — inference-hosted: error-rate spike (500s) across api-production-us-west. Paging Maya (primary) and Cheng (secondary). Incident runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/inference/500-spike

Maya: acked. I'm primary, seeing the same in grafana. I'm at SFO, flight delayed. I can handle triage for 15-20m but won't be at keyboard after 23:15 PST. Can someone cover the midnight handoff window? :airplane:

Cheng: taking secondary standby. i'll jump in if you need immediate mitigation. Can you paste quick handoff steps?

Maya: quick notes — current mitigation flow in order:
1) verify the spike is pod-level vs model variant: grafana quick check
2) if model-serving pods show high 5xx, scale down new replicas and roll back to last good model
3) if cache miss storm, toggle kv-cache bypass
4) escalate to infra if redis errors show connection resets

Commands: 
```
# list inference pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-inference
# tail logs for failing replica
kubectl -n inference logs -f pod/inf-srv-22 --container=router
# scale down rollout
kubectl -n inference scale deploy inf-deployment --replicas=2
```

Maya: i'll leave a runbook link and the most recent rollback sha: sha: f3b7c9d. Also note: recent canary rolled 4 hours ago (canary-id: canary-2026-03-13-09)

Sam: I can cover midnight-01:00 PST. @Maya do you want me to be primary starting 23:20? I can take the page if it fires after that. :thumbsup:

Maya: yes please @Sam — i'm boarding soon. handoff checklist:
- post check-in here
- confirm you can access k8s and grafana dashboards
- adjust rotation in the oncall calendar (SchedulerBot can update)
- call Cheng if you need to escalate

Sam: done. i'm attached to VPN and have kubectl access. taking primary from 23:20 — will monitor until 01:00. I'll add a note to the incident channel if things change.

Ravi: heads up to ops: there's a coverage gap between 01:00-02:00 PST tonight because my night shift starts at 02:00 and i'm on pager for infra. If nobody volunteers i'll extend. Anyone free for 01:00-02:00?

Cheng: I can extend to 01:30 if needed, but can't go beyond 02:00. if we need full cover, @Ravi can you take 01:30-02:00?

Ravi: I can take 01:30-02:00 but prefer not to extend earlier. Let's try to avoid gap — Sam, can you push to 01:30 instead of 01:00?

Sam: sure, I can extend to 01:30. I'll update the rotation.

SchedulerBot: rotation update request received. Sam set as primary 2026-03-13T23:20:00-08:00 to 2026-03-14T01:30:00-08:00. Maya set to secondary for remainder of her shift. Reminder: update personal calendars. :calendar:

Maya: thanks team. leaving detailed logs in the incident doc: https://internal.incidents/2026-03-13-inference-500s

Oncall Bot: note — P1 still firing, mitigation in progress. Please annotate incident timeline when making changes. 

Sam: will do. starting active monitoring now. ping here for any action. :white_check_mark:

Cheng: copied. standing by for escalation.

Maya: boarding now, signing off from keyboard. thanks all. :wave:

SchedulerBot: rotation change persisted. Audit id: audit-7721.
